entities.name: Amaurosis fugax
observations: Painless transient monocular blindness with complete recovery is clinically consistent with transient retinal ischemia.
Carotid embolism or stenosis is a key treatable cause requiring urgent TIA/stroke evaluation.

entities.name: Carotid Doppler ultrasound
observations: Bilateral carotid duplex is the preferred initial routine test for detecting and grading extracranial carotid stenosis.
It is noninvasive and avoids iodinated contrast and gadolinium, making it suitable in stage 4 chronic kidney disease.

entities.name: Dilated ophthalmoscopy
observations: Dilated retinal examination is complementary for retinal or embolic pathology but does not adequately evaluate the extracranial carotid source in suspected amaurosis fugax.
